paragraphs: Rav Giyora. Rabbi Yaakov, son of Rav Giyora, said in the name of Rabbi Yochanan: chapter Megallechin, 18a, and the end of Taanit. Rashi explains: the name of a person. It is an error, and should read “Rav Yitzchak, son of Rav Yaakov bar Giyorei.”
